title: Generate 4-view (full body front, full body rear, front close-up, profile…
content:
Generate 4-view (full body front, full body rear, front close-up, profile close-up) character reference sheets for each character in GPT Image 2 on a neutral grey background with clean studio lighting, no text/watermarks, then upload them as reference_image in every Seedance generation to keep character consistency.

Use copyright-safe style wording like 3D animated cartoon style and CGI animated feature film quality while explicitly adding NOT photorealistic and avoiding brand names (e.g., no Pixar) in Seedance prompts.

Include explicit camera direction in the prompt (e.g., static wide shot, slight low angle, quick push-in; smooth orbit at waist height; slow-motion tracking; whip-pan) to control shot motion and pacing.

Add SET LAYOUT constraints in the prompt (object positions, distances like 5–7 meters, who stays fixed, what moves) to reduce continuity errors and prevent clipping/bounce artifacts.

For fast montage sequences, specify quick-cut montage with clean stable shots and no camera shake artifacts to keep edits energetic without introducing jitter.

When a precise interaction must happen (e.g., pizza box lands perfectly in hands), explicitly state the required outcome and constraints (no clipping, no bounce, both characters remain planted, only the object travels) in the prompt.

Split a 30-second short into multiple Seedance generations by time-coded scenes (e.g., 0–4s, 4–9s, 9–15s, etc.) to maintain control over beats and continuity.

Plan sound design per scene (whooshes, dings, stingers, engine revs) alongside the visual prompt to guide timing and comedic beats during editing.

Utilisez un wording de style compatible avec le copyright, comme 3D animated cartoon style et CGI animated feature film quality, tout en ajoutant explicitement NOT photorealistic et en évitant les noms de marques (par ex. pas de Pixar) dans les prompts Seedance.

Incluez une direction de caméra explicite dans le prompt (par ex. static wide shot, slight low angle, quick push-in; smooth orbit at waist height; slow-motion tracking; whip-pan) pour contrôler le mouvement du plan et le rythme.

Ajoutez des contraintes SET LAYOUT dans le prompt (positions des objets, distances comme 5–7 meters, qui reste fixe, ce qui bouge) afin de réduire les erreurs de continuité et d’éviter les artefacts de clipping/bounce.

Pour les séquences de montage rapides, précisez quick-cut montage avec clean stable shots et no camera shake artifacts afin de garder un montage énergique sans introduire de jitter.

Découpez un court-métrage de 30 secondes en plusieurs générations Seedance par scènes horodatées (par ex. 0–4s, 4–9s, 9–15s, etc.) afin de garder le contrôle sur les temps forts et la continuité.

ja.content:
---
GPT Image 2 で各キャラクターごとに、ニュートラルなグレー背景、クリーンなスタジオ照明、テキスト／ウォーターマークなしで、4ビュー（全身正面、全身背面、正面クローズアップ、横顔クローズアップ）のキャラクター・リファレンスシートを生成し、それらを各 Seedance の生成時に reference_image としてアップロードして、キャラクターの一貫性を保ちます。

Seedance の prompt では、3D animated cartoon style や CGI animated feature film quality のような著作権的に安全なスタイル表現を使い、NOT photorealistic を明示的に追加し、ブランド名（例: Pixar）は避けてください。

ショットの動きとテンポを制御するために、prompt 内で明確なカメラ指示を含めてください（例: static wide shot, slight low angle, quick push-in; smooth orbit at waist height; slow-motion tracking; whip-pan）。

連続性のエラーを減らし、clipping や bounce のアーティファクトを防ぐために、prompt に SET LAYOUT の制約（オブジェクトの位置、5〜7 meters のような距離、誰が固定されるか、何が動くか）を追加してください。

高速な montage シーケンスでは、編集をエネルギッシュに保ちながら jitter を発生させないように、quick-cut montage with clean stable shots and no camera shake artifacts と指定してください。

正確なインタラクションが必要な場合（例: pizza box がちょうど手の中に着地する）、必要な結果と制約（no clipping, no bounce, both characters remain planted, only the object travels）を prompt 内で明示してください。

30秒の短編は、時間コード付きのシーン（例: 0–4s, 4–9s, 9–15s など）に分けて複数の Seedance 生成に分割し、ビートと連続性のコントロールを維持してください。

編集時のタイミングとコメディのビートを導くために、視覚的な prompt と並行して、シーンごとのサウンドデザイン（whooshes, dings, stingers, engine revs）を計画してください。
---

ko.content:
각 캐릭터에 대해 GPT Image 2에서 4뷰(전신 정면, 전신 후면, 정면 클로즈업, 측면 클로즈업) 캐릭터 레퍼런스 시트를 중립적인 회색 배경과 깔끔한 스튜디오 조명으로 생성한 뒤, 텍스트/워터마크 없이 저장하고, 캐릭터 일관성을 유지하기 위해 모든 Seedance 생성에서 이를 reference_image로 업로드하세요.

Seedance 프롬프트에서는 3D animated cartoon style, CGI animated feature film quality 같은 저작권 안전한 스타일 표현을 사용하되, NOT photorealistic를 명시적으로 추가하고 브랜드명(예: Pixar)은 피하세요.

샷의 움직임과 템포를 제어하기 위해 프롬프트에 명시적인 카메라 지시를 포함하세요(예: static wide shot, slight low angle, quick push-in; smooth orbit at waist height; slow-motion tracking; whip-pan).

연속성 오류를 줄이고 clipping/bounce 아티팩트를 방지하기 위해 프롬프트에 SET LAYOUT 제약(오브젝트 위치, 5–7 meters 같은 거리, 무엇이 고정되고 무엇이 움직이는지)을 추가하세요.

빠른 몽타주 시퀀스의 경우, 편집을 에너지 있게 유지하면서 jitter가 생기지 않도록 quick-cut montage with clean stable shots and no camera shake artifacts라고 명시하세요.

정확한 상호작용이 반드시 일어나야 할 때(예: 피자 박스가 정확히 손에 떨어짐)는, 필요한 결과와 제약(no clipping, no bounce, both characters remain planted, only the object travels)을 프롬프트에 명시적으로 적으세요.

30초짜리 숏폼은 시간 코드가 있는 장면들(예: 0–4s, 4–9s, 9–15s 등)로 나누어 여러 Seedance 생성으로 분할해, 비트와 연속성을 더 잘 제어하세요.

시각적 프롬프트와 함께 장면별 사운드 디자인(whooshes, dings, stingers, engine revs)을 계획해, 편집 시 타이밍과 코미디 비트를 안내하세요.

pt.content:
Gere folhas de referência de personagem em 4 vistas (corpo inteiro de frente, corpo inteiro de costas, close-up frontal, close-up de perfil) para cada personagem no GPT Image 2, sobre um fundo cinza neutro com iluminação de estúdio limpa, sem texto/marcas d’água, e depois faça o upload delas como reference_image em cada geração do Seedance para manter a consistência dos personagens.

Use uma formulação de estilo segura em relação a direitos autorais, como 3D animated cartoon style e CGI animated feature film quality, enquanto adiciona explicitamente NOT photorealistic e evita nomes de marcas (por exemplo, sem Pixar) nos prompts do Seedance.

Inclua direção de câmera explícita no prompt (por exemplo, static wide shot, slight low angle, quick push-in; smooth orbit at waist height; slow-motion tracking; whip-pan) para controlar o movimento da cena e o ritmo.

Adicione restrições de SET LAYOUT no prompt (posições dos objetos, distâncias como 5–7 meters, quem permanece fixo, o que se move) para reduzir erros de continuidade e evitar artefatos de clipping/bounce.

Para sequências rápidas de montagem, especifique quick-cut montage com clean stable shots e sem camera shake artifacts para manter as edições energéticas sem introduzir jitter.

Quando uma interação precisa acontecer com precisão (por exemplo, a caixa de pizza aterrissa perfeitamente nas mãos), declare explicitamente o resultado e as restrições necessárias (no clipping, no bounce, both characters remain planted, only the object travels) no prompt.

Divida um short de 30 segundos em várias gerações do Seedance por cenas com marcação de tempo (por exemplo, 0–4s, 4–9s, 9–15s etc.) para manter o controle sobre os beats e a continuidade.

Planeje o sound design por cena (whooshes, dings, stingers, engine revs) junto com o prompt visual para orientar o timing e os beats cômicos durante a edição.

zh.content:
为每个角色在 GPT Image 2 中生成 4 视图（正面全身、背面全身、正面特写、侧面特写）角色参考图，使用中性灰背景、干净的棚拍灯光、无文字/水印，然后将它们作为 reference_image 上传到每一次 Seedance 生成中，以保持角色一致性。

在 Seedance prompts 中，使用版权安全的风格表述，例如 3D animated cartoon style 和 CGI animated feature film quality，同时明确加入 NOT photorealistic，并避免使用品牌名称（例如不要写 Pixar）。

在 prompt 中加入明确的镜头指令（例如 static wide shot, slight low angle, quick push-in; smooth orbit at waist height; slow-motion tracking; whip-pan），以控制镜头运动和节奏。

在 prompt 中加入 SET LAYOUT 约束（物体位置、距离如 5–7 meters、谁保持固定、谁在移动），以减少连续性错误并防止 clipping/bounce artifacts。

对于快速蒙太奇序列，指定 quick-cut montage with clean stable shots and no camera shake artifacts，以保持剪辑有活力，同时避免抖动。

当必须发生精确互动时（例如 pizza box lands perfectly in hands），在 prompt 中明确写出所需结果和约束（no clipping, no bounce, both characters remain planted, only the object travels）。

将一个 30 秒短片按时间编码场景拆分为多个 Seedance 生成片段（例如 0–4s、4–9s、9–15s 等），以便更好地控制节拍和连续性。

在视觉 prompt 的同时，为每个场景规划 sound design（whooshes、dings、stingers、engine revs），以便在剪辑时指导节奏和喜剧点。
